tests.name: error-catch-binding
tests.description: Caught error exposes code and message fields
tests.source: export function test(): string { try { throw { code: "E_TEST", message: "test" }; } catch (e) { return e.code; } }

tests.name: error-message-field
tests.source: export function test(): string { try { throw { code: "E_TEST", message: "hello" }; } catch (e) { return e.message; } }

tests.name: error-runtime-oob
tests.description: Array OOB produces runtime error with code E8001
tests.source: export function test(): int { let xs: int[] = [1, 2, 3]; return xs[10]; }
